vertex block at offset 141, 2292 records of 76 bytes
index block at offset 174349, 3660 u16 indices, 1220 triangles, max index 2291
vertex fields: position at +0, UV at +12, normal at +20, colour at +32, four blend weights at +36 summing to 1.0, tangent at +52, bitangent at +64
base texture Creatures/pc/hero02.tex decoded from the TEX container to a 512x512 DXT1 DDS and then to RGB
software rasteriser with a z-buffer, per-pixel texture sampling and one directional light
